description: This file defines various miscellaneous converter classes used in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides conversions between SQL Blob/Clob types and Java types, enum to string conversions, locale conversions, format objects to string and vice versa, charset conversions, UUID, and regex pattern conversions. These converters are likely used globally within the project for data transformation tasks.

classes.name: MiscConverters
classes.description: Main class providing a loader for various converter implementations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BlobToBlob
classes.description: Converts a Blob object to a new Blob instance, essentially cloning the Blob.

classes.name: BlobToByteArray
classes.description: Converts a Blob into a byte array.

classes.name: ByteArrayToBlob
classes.description: Converts a byte array into a Blob.

classes.name: ByteBufferToByteArray
classes.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a byte array, returning the underlying array if available.

classes.name: ByteArrayToByteBuffer
classes.description: Wraps a byte array into a ByteBuffer.

classes.name: ClobToString
classes.description: Reads a Clob's character stream and converts it into a String.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: Converts an Enum to its name string.

classes.name: StringToEnumConverterCreator
classes.description: Creates converters from String to Enum types.

classes.name: StringToEnum
classes.description: Converts a String to an Enum of a specified type.

classes.name: LocaleToString
classes.description: Converts a Locale object to its string representation.

classes.name: StringToClob
classes.description: Converts a String into a Clob.

classes.name: StringToLocale
classes.description: Parses a String into a Locale object.

classes.name: DecimalFormatToString
classes.description: Converts a DecimalFormat object to its pattern string.

classes.name: StringToDecimalFormat
classes.description: Creates a DecimalFormat object from a pattern string.

classes.name: SimpleDateFormatToString
classes.description: Converts a SimpleDateFormat object to its pattern string.

classes.name: StringToSimpleDateFormat
classes.description: Creates a SimpleDateFormat object from a pattern string.

classes.name: CharsetToString
classes.description: Converts a Charset object to its string name.

classes.name: StringToCharset
classes.description: Creates a Charset from its string name.

classes.name: StringBufferToString
classes.description: Converts a StringBuffer to a String.

classes.name: StringWrapperToString
classes.description: Converts a StringWrapper to a String.

classes.name: UUIDToString
classes.description: Converts a UUID to its string representation.

classes.name: StringToUUID
classes.description: Converts a string into a UUID.

classes.name: RegexPatternToString
classes.description: Converts a regex Pattern to its string form.

classes.name: StringToRegexPattern
classes.description: Creates a regex Pattern from a string.

classes.name: NotAConverterHelper
classes.description: Helper class that should not be loaded; likely used as a marker or for preventing instantiation.

classes.name: NotAConverter
classes.description: Placeholder class indicating a non-converter entity.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads or registers contained converters for use within the framework.
